bibl.title: Egyptian textiles and their production: 'word' and 'object' (Hellenistic, Roman and Byzantine periods)
bibl.seg: Maria Mossakowska-Gaubert (ed.), Egyptian textiles and their production: 'word' and 'object' (Hellenistic, Roman and Byzantine periods) = Zea E-Books. 86.
Lincoln, Nebraska, Zea Books, 2020, 153 pp., figg. ISBN 978-1-60962-153-7.
bibl.note: This volume presents the results of a workshop, which took place on 24 November 2017 at the Centre for Textile Re-search (CTR), University of Copenhagen. 12 contributions. - M.M.-G., Introduction. - Part I. Weaving looms: texts, images, remains. - Part II. Technology of weaving: study cases. - Part III. Dyeing: terminology and technology. - Part IV. Textile production in written sources: organisation and economy. - P. 153: Dominique Cardon, Conclusion.
